QuestInfo.name: [Replay Event] Alliance Support
QuestInfo.0: Get your gift from the Maple Administrator if you're a more powerful thief or pirate!
QuestInfo.1: You'll receive 1 #bSpecial Mastery Book#k if you reach Level 70 with a pirate or a thief.
QuestInfo.2: You've received a Mastery Book from the Maple Administrator! Make the most of it!

1.0: Good day to you, #h0#. The thieves and pirates of the world are becoming stronger after their awakening. That's why we've prepared a special gift for those special adventurers who reach Level 70. You can take one #e#bSpecial Mastery Book#k#n of your liking!

yes.0: You can use the Special Mastery Book to boost a 4th advancement skill's Master Level. Pretty impressive, huh?
